questions.question:
다음 대화문의 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

(1)
G: Did you hear the weather report?
B: Yes. It's going to rain all day long.
G: Really? _____(A)_____ I can wear my new raincoat.
B: Good for you.

(2)
G: What's the weather going to be like?
B: I'm afraid it'll rain.
G: Oh, no! _____(B)_____ I won't be able to walk my dog.
B: I'm sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation: (A)에서는 비가 와서 새 우비를 입을 수 있다고 기뻐하고 있으므로 'I'm glad'가 적절합니다. (B)에서는 비가 와서 강아지를 산책시킬 수 없다고 걱정하고 있으므로 'I'm worried'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her palace. When dinner ⓐwas served, rats appeared, and some servants ⓑchased them away with sticks.
Antonio was greatly surprised that there ⓒwas rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.
The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them ⓓrun free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats ⓔto run away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 골라 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'was served'는 수동태로 옳습니다. ⓑ 'chased them away'는 능동태로 옳습니다. ⓒ 'there was rats'는 복수 주어이므로 'were'가 되어야 합니다. ⓓ 'let them run free'에서 let+목적어+동사원형 구조로 옳습니다. ⓔ 'saw all the rats to run away'에서 지각동사 saw의 목적격 보어로 to부정사는 쓸 수 없고 동사원형이나 현재분사를 써야 하므로 틀렸습니다. 따라서 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ입니다.

options: The Priceless Gift for the Queen

questions.question:
[지문]
Back in Italy, Antonio told his friends about his good fortune. Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are worthless," Luigi thought. "I'll bring the queen what is really valuable. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels."
Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie ⓐthat he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen.
Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio. After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented ⓑthat to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless.
There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts ⓒthat you gave us, we want to give you (A)what is most valuable to us."
Luigi realized ⓓthat in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew ⓔthat ⓕthat was the right thing to do.

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ의 that 중, 같은 문법적 기능을 하는 것끼리 올바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 동격의 that(a lie that ~), ⓒ는 관계대명사 that(gifts that you gave us)입니다. ⓑ는 지시대명사 that(the box를 가리킴), ⓓ는 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 that(realized that ~), ⓔ는 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 that(knew that ~), ⓕ는 지시대명사 that(that was the right thing)입니다. 같은 기능끼리 묶으면: 동격/관계대명사 ⓐ,ⓒ와 지시대명사 ⓑ,ⓓ... 실제로 ⓐ(동격의 that), ⓒ(관계대명사 that)은 명사를 수식하는 역할이고, ⓑ(지시대명사), ⓓ,ⓔ(접속사 that)입니다. 정답은 ⓐ,ⓒ(명사 수식) - ⓑ,ⓓ(지시대명사/접속사)로 ①번입니다.

options: I saw the thief run away.

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 지각동사(hear, see, watch, feel 등)의 목적격 보어로는 동사원형 또는 현재분사를 사용합니다. 'to부정사'는 사용할 수 없습니다. 따라서 'She heard someone to sing loudly.'에서 'to sing'은 'sing' 또는 'singing'으로 바꿔야 합니다.

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ① 'That I need'에서 That은 선행사 없이 주어 역할을 할 수 없으므로 What으로 바꿔야 합니다. ② 'Hiking is what I usually do in my free time.'은 what이 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 올바르게 사용되었습니다. ③ what절 안에 told의 목적어(me)와 진주어(the truth)가 중복되어 어색합니다. ④ 지각동사 heard의 목적격 보어로 to talk 대신 talk 또는 talking을 써야 합니다. ⑤ what절 안에 주어(it)가 중복되므로 'what makes her popular'로 써야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 모두 찾으시오.

ⓐ I felt the land shaken.
ⓑ Minho heard me singing.
ⓒ Mom saw I am reading a book.
ⓓ I saw my brother downloaded the movie.
ⓔ I heard Mom whisper something to my sister.
questions.explanation:
지각동사(see, hear, feel 등)의 목적격 보어로는 동사원형, 현재분사(-ing), 과거분사(-ed)가 올 수 있습니다.
ⓐ felt the land shaken: shaken은 과거분사로 '땅이 흔들리는 것을 느꼈다'는 의미인데, 땅이 흔들리는 것은 능동의 의미이므로 shaking이 더 적절합니다. (shaken은 수동의 의미)
ⓑ heard me singing: 지각동사 hear + 목적어 me + 현재분사 singing → 올바른 문장
ⓒ Mom saw I am reading a book: 지각동사의 목적어 자리에 'I am reading'처럼 절을 쓸 수 없습니다. 'Mom saw me reading a book'이 올바른 형태
ⓓ I saw my brother downloaded the movie: 지각동사의 목적격 보어 자리에 과거형 동사(downloaded)를 쓸 수 없습니다. download 또는 downloading이 올바른 형태
ⓔ heard Mom whisper: 지각동사 hear + 목적어 Mom + 동사원형 whisper → 올바른 문장

questions.question:
다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 단어와 같은 단어가 들어가는 문장은?

I will never forget ___________ you told me today.

① I don't care ___________ you come from.
② Anna was happy ___________ hear the news.
③ ___________ I want to eat right now is the secret soup of my mom.
④ Let me help you to find the person ___________ found your bag.
⑤ Keeping my word is the thing ___________ is the most important to me.
questions.explanation:
메인 문장의 빈칸: 'I will never forget ___ you told me today.' → what(무엇을)이 들어가야 합니다. 'what you told me today'는 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what으로 '네가 오늘 나에게 말한 것'이라는 의미의 명사절입니다.
① where(어디서) - 출신지를 묻는 간접의문문
② to(to부정사) - be happy to
③ What - 'What I want to eat right now'에서 What이 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 사용 → 정답
④ who(관계대명사) - 사람 선행사
⑤ that(관계대명사) - the thing that

questions.question:
빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 표현을 찾아 짝지은 것은?

There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you what is most valuable to us." Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth (A)_______ more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look (B)_______ with the gift. He knew that was the right thing to do. Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser (C)_______.

(A) / (B) / (C)
questions.explanation:
(A) far: 비교급 강조 부사로 far, much, even, still, a lot 등이 사용됩니다. 'worth far more'처럼 비교급 앞에는 far가 적절합니다. very는 비교급을 강조할 수 없습니다.
(B) pleased: 'look pleased'는 '기쁜/만족스러운 표정을 짓다'라는 의미로, 사람의 감정을 나타낼 때는 pleased(기쁜)가 적절합니다. pleasing은 '즐거움을 주는'의 의미로 사람에게 쓰기 어색합니다.
(C) one: 앞에서 언급된 'a richer man'에서 man을 대신하는 부정대명사 one이 적절합니다. 'a wiser one'으로 사용됩니다.

options: What did Antonio trade tools for in the island?
What appeared when dinner was served?
How many rats were chased away by servants?
Were there cats on the island?
questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her place. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks.

Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them run free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats run away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

위 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation:
① Antonio의 직업은 상인(merchant)이라고 나와 있습니다.
② Antonio는 도구를 향신료(spices)와 교환했다고 나와 있습니다.
③ 저녁식사가 제공될 때 쥐들(rats)이 나타났다고 나와 있습니다.
④ 몇 마리의 쥐가 쫓겨났는지는 글에 나와 있지 않습니다. 단지 '일부 하인들이 막대기로 쥐들을 쫓아냈다'고만 나와 있습니다.
⑤ 섬에는 고양이가 없었다고 나와 있습니다(여왕이 '고양이가 무엇이냐'고 물어봄).

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and Ⓐhe went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. ⒷThere he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what Ⓒthey needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her place. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased Ⓓthem away with sticks.

Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let Ⓔthem run free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats run away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

ⓐ~ⓔ 중 지칭하는 대상이 올바르게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation:
Ⓐhe: Antonio를 가리킵니다. (Luigi가 아님)
ⒷThere: 멀리 있는 섬(a faraway island)을 가리킵니다. (Genoa, Italy가 아님)
ⓒthey: 섬 주민들(the islanders)을 가리킵니다. (servants가 아님)
ⓓthem: 쥐들(rats)을 가리킵니다. (the islanders가 아님)
ⓔthem: 배에서 데려온 고양이 두 마리(two cats)를 가리킵니다. → 올바른 연결

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he ⓐtraded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her palace. When dinner was ⓑserved, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks. Antonio was greatly ⓒpleased that there were rats in her palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked ⓓpuzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them running free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats running away. She gave Antonio a chest that was ⓔfilled with jewels.

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓒpleased: 문맥상 Antonio는 궁궐에 쥐가 있다는 사실에 '크게 놀랐다(surprised)'고 해야 합니다. 쥐가 있다는 것이 기쁜(pleased) 상황이 아니므로 문맥상 적절하지 않습니다. 실제 본문에서도 'greatly surprised'로 나와 있습니다.
나머지는 모두 문맥상 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he ⓐtraded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.

위 글에서 <보기>의 의미에 해당하는 단어를 고르시오.

<보기>
someone who buys and sells products in large amounts
questions.explanation: 'someone who buys and sells products in large amounts'는 '대량으로 상품을 사고파는 사람'을 의미하며, 이는 '상인(merchant)'을 설명하는 것입니다.

questions.question:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절하게 짝지어진 것은?

• The doctor said that the operation would be simple and ___(A)___.
• Astronauts travel into outer space and work in a ___(B)___ environment.

(A) / (B)
questions.explanation:
(A) painless: '수술이 간단하고 ___할 것이다'라는 문맥에서 '고통 없는(painless)'이 적절합니다. 수술과 관련하여 pain(고통) + less = painless(고통 없는)
(B) weightless: '우주비행사들이 우주에서 ___ 환경에서 일한다'는 문맥에서 '무중력의(weightless)'가 적절합니다. weight(무게) + less = weightless(무게 없는, 무중력의)

questions.question:
다음 글에서 나타난 Luigi의 심경 변화로 가장 알맞은 것은?

Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen.

Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.

After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless. There was a kitten in the box.
questions.explanation:
Luigi는 처음에 안토니오보다 더 많은 보석을 받을 것이라고 확신하며 '흥분되고 희망에 찬(excited and hopeful)' 상태였습니다. 하지만 상자를 열었을 때 새끼 고양이가 있어 말문이 막혔습니다(speechless). 이는 예상과 전혀 다른 선물을 받아 '당황스러운(puzzled)' 상태로 변한 것입니다.
따라서 심경 변화는 'excited → puzzled'가 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
주어진 글에 이어질 내용을 논리적 순서에 맞게 배열한 것은?

Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders, a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's.

(A) There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you what is most valuable to us."
(B) Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.
(C) When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a priceless gift," said the queen.
(D) After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless.
questions.explanation:
주어진 글: Luigi가 선물을 싣고 섬에 도착해 안토니오의 친구라고 거짓말을 함
(C): 여왕이 Luigi를 초대하고 선물을 받은 후 '귀한 선물로 보답하겠다'고 함
(B): Luigi가 여왕이 하인에게 귀엣말하는 것을 보고 보석을 받을 것이라 기대함
(D): 하인이 상자를 가져오고 Luigi가 열었을 때 말문이 막힘
(A): 상자 안에 새끼 고양이가 있었고 여왕이 설명함
따라서 순서는 (C) - (B) - (D) - (A)

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Long ago, an honest ①______ lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places ②______ by trading. One day, he filled his ship with ③______ and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools and books for spices and nuts which the islanders sold. ④______ Antonio, the ⑤______ could get what they needed.
questions.explanation:
③ spices and nuts: 본문에서 Antonio는 배에 '상품(goods)'을 싣고 섬으로 갔습니다. 또한 그는 도구와 책을 향신료와 견과류로 교환했으므로, 배에 실은 것은 향신료와 견과류가 아니라 도구와 책 등의 goods입니다. 따라서 ③ 'spices and nuts'는 빈칸에 들어가기에 적절하지 않습니다.
나머지: ① trader(상인 → merchant와 유사), ② to make a living(생계를 위해 → support his family와 유사), ④ Because of(~ 덕분에 → Thanks to와 유사), ⑤ people of the island(섬 주민들 → islanders와 유사)는 모두 적절합니다.
